clips.title: The story
paras: Across the sea, Alliance warlocks seek Menara Voidrender in the Barrens. From Strahad Farsan's tower above Ratchet, she teaches seasoned practitioners to craft tools and garments that strengthen their control of demons.

Briarthorn sees when a warlock has moved beyond basic demonology and resisted corruption. He sends those pupils beyond Ironforge, across the sea to Kalimdor, instead of keeping them beneath the mountain. There, they can learn practical felcraft from an artisan with greater skill.

Strahad Farsan keeps a solitary tower on the bluffs above Ratchet. Warlocks often set aside racial and political borders to survive in a world wary of dark magic. Menara Voidrender stays at Strahad's sanctuary and works with warlocks of every allegiance, helping them sharpen their craft and keep their summoned fiends bound.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, hello, friend. You're progressing well in your training. So well in fact that I think you should be rewarded for your hard work--and for not becoming corrupted by the arcane yet.
If you're interested, seek out Menara Voidrender in Ratchet. She is currently staying at Strahad Farsan's tower overlooking the town.
She's not very friendly, friend, so don't expect any praise. But if you work hard, she'll make sure you're taken care of.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Briarthorn sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.

It is typical of our kind, friend, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
I feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
